name: The Binding

narrative.details:
If you are sufficiently prepared, then we should begin. Let me explain the process to you.

I will begin by creating the basic summoning circle. When that is finished, my acolytes will use the rods of channeling to create the greater circle.

Once that is done, read the incantation from the Tome of the Cabal, and the felhunter will be pulled forth. Be careful, adventurer. A felhunter is a powerful foe, and I'd like to see you keep your head on your shoulders.
narrative.objectives: Using the Tome of the Cabal, summon and subdue a felhunter, then return the Tome of the Cabal to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
narrative.offerRewardText: I must say I'm impressed, adventurer. When I faced down my felhunter, I barely escaped with my life. I sense that you have the potential to become one of the most powerful warlocks of this era.
narrative.requestItemsText: Every warlock should have a felhunter at his command. Though it be difficult to tame, the powers it brings to its master far outweigh the cost.
